worker_count_followup.interpretation: Observed unsigned 0 to 0xFFFFFFFF wrap through the retail worker path. Whether a negative count is an error or an intended queue/waiter state is unresolved; no semantic patch was made.

interpretation.finding: The first 128 Process 2 PM4_INTERRUPT records each coincide with one retail source-1 callback; all carry CPU mask 0x04 and dispatch CPU 2. Later, the registered retail callback switches to 0x823B8C60 and its worker queue drains every observed queued item.
not_proven: An offline race or complete Linux port.
That manager+11012 wrapping to 0xFFFFFFFF is a defect.
That submission, interrupt, or worker counts prove rendered gameplay.
